text:
olivia: FYI — customer (org: org_89c2) reports they redeemed a promo via the JS SDK, SDK returned 200 and they received the confirmation email, but their dashboard balance is still 0.

olivia: payload they sent (redacted):
```js
await Redwood.redeemPromo({ code: 'WELCOME-50', org_id: 'org_89c2', idempotency_key: 'idemp-20240318-xyz' })
// SDK v0.9.3 -> response 200 { claimed: true, message: 'redeemed' }
```

olivia: customer says email shows "$50 credit granted". UI shows zero credit. Can someone check ingestion/ledger?

sam_engineering: can you paste the request_id from the SDK response or the confirmation email headers? need to trace through webhook/redeem service.

olivia: request-id in email: req_0a1b2c3d, redeem_time: 1719998875, partner: web-claim. I've attached their confirmation email screenshot in the ticket.

maria_billing: looked up req_0a1b2c3d in payments logs — we have a promo.claim event at 2024-03-18T12:21:15Z with amount 50.00 but ledger shows an entry with amount 0.00 and reason="promo_ingest_null". this smells like a mapping/transformation bug in the ingestion lambda.

sam_engineering: interesting. can we query the promo-events topic? maybe the transformer lost the amount field. ingest-bot: replay tooling shows last successful transform for that partition at 1719998850. there was a transient error in transform v2.1.4 that defaulted missing amounts to 0.0.

ingest-bot: event raw payload (sanitized):
```
{"event":"promo.claim","org_id":"org_89c2","amount":50.00,"promo_code":"WELCOME-50","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d"}
```

maria_billing: but the ledger row we have is: `event_id=evt_5544, org=org_89c2, amount=0.00, applied_to=billing_account_zzx` — applied_to looks correct. transform must have rewritten amount to zero before ledger write.

sam_engineering: ok reproducing steps: transform v2.1.4 has a fallback when amount === null -> set 0. We need to check why amount disappeared between webhook and transform. Can either be schema mismatch (promo service changed field to cents vs dollars) or a bug in the binary codec.

olivia: customer is getting upset, asking for ETA. They've avoided using app features because balance shows nothing.

maria_billing: immediate mitigation: we can credit the account manually with a one-off ledger adjustment and link it to the original request_id so billing backfill won't double-credit. I'll prepare a manual credit but want sign-off from eng for root cause, and a rollback plan.

sam_engineering: agree with manual credit to unblock customer. I'll open infra PR to revert transform to previous behavior and add strict schema validation so malformed/missing amounts fail loud. ETA for PR + deploy to staging: ~2h. Production deploy after smoke tests: +3h.

olivia: thanks. please tag customer success. Customer is: matt@acmeinc.com (case 64219). I'll note manual credit and upcoming fix.

maria_billing: done — queued manual ledger entry: +50.00 USD, reference=req_0a1b2c3d, pending until eng confirms not to double-apply.

sam_engineering: I'll also run a replay of the promo-events partition from 1719998800..1719998900 to find any other affected events. will post results here.

ingest-bot: replay job started (job_id=replay-772): scanning 100 messages, found 3 events with amount==0 that should be >0.

sam_engineering: found root cause: transform v2.1.4 introduced an inadvertent JSON path change (amount -> details.amount) when handling partner integrations; most partners had backward compat, but web-claim still emits top-level amount. transformer code looked up details.amount and treated top-level amount as optional -> fell back to null -> coerced to 0. Fix is to accept both paths. patch incoming.

olivia: great detective work. maria, hold manual credit until sam confirms replay + fix won't reapply.

maria_billing: holding. I set the ledger entry status=hold.

sam_engineering: PR opened: github.com/redwood/integrations/compare/fix/promo-transform-amt (link). running CI -> staging deploy in ~40m. will update when staging looks good.

olivia: please @mention me when deploy is done so I can update the customer. :thumbsup:

sam_engineering: staging deploy succeeded. ran smoke over sample events; amounts preserved. will schedule a 15min prod deploy at 14:00 UTC with a migration script to correct the affected ledger rows (update amount from 0 -> 50 where reference=req_0a1b2c3d or job replay matched).

olmaria: quick note — after replay + migration, I'll unhold the manual ledger entry only if the migration didn't already credit the account to avoid duplication.

maria_billing: prod migration completed. corrected 3 ledger rows. verified org_89c2 balance now shows +50.00. manual hold entry canceled.

olivia: customer notified, they confirmed balance updated. closing case 64219. thanks everyone.

sam_engineering: adding a test to CI to validate both paths (top-level amount and details.amount) so this doesn't regress.

olivia: closing the thread.
